speaker: abel_garnish
text: The plot is on the peg. The hired men can find their doors from it. I am not teaching them the play. I am teaching them the list.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave them the list. I have one line that will not leave my mouth, and the mouth is the morning's whole complaint.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou art chewing it, Will. Say the throne, and let the rest of England follow if it can.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: This royall throne of Kings, this sceptred Ile,

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It breaks on sceptred. The throne will stand. The adjective will not, not this morning.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then say it again, and do not apologise to an empty yard. The yard is not here to forgive thee.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Again from the chair. Gaunt is carried. He is not strolling. Augustine, the chair is where we left it yesterday.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The chair is here. The glass is on the seat, face up, where he put it. I have not touched it, and I am not going to.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I put it there. I take it off when I must sit, and I put it back when I rise. Nobody is to ask me why. Not this week.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not asking. The glass is not in the speech I am failing, and I have trouble enough with the speech.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Shall I stand by the chair, sir, or by the door? The gown is not on me this morning. I only want the place.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: By the door, Nick. Thou art not in this speech. Thou art in the house, and the house can wait one line.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Then I will be still, sir. Still is the work, when the line is not mine.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Give him the line without the stumble announced. A yard hears the word, or it hears a man telling it the word was hard. I know which of those I can follow on a lute.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: This royall throne of Kings, this sceptred Ile,

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There. It is ugly, and it is said. I will not call it mended.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Ugly will do till Thursday. Thou hast the rest of the speech in thee. Do not spend it on a rehearsal that has already had the first breath.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The Master's cut still shows, like a drawn tooth, since we are speaking of teeth. I am not putting back what he took. The king goes off a king and comes on a prisoner, and York may report the rest. That is the book.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the book. I am not writing the missing scene back into a Monday because a line stumbled.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Then we are rehearsing a wound, and calling it the fourth act. I can tune to a wound. I cannot tune to a scene that is not on the roll.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Tune to the wound. I will sit the throne when the glass is off it, and I will not explain the glass to anyone who has a list in his hand.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: They have been told where to stand. They do not need the glass explained. They need the second door, and they have it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. One broken word is enough for a morning. I am due at home before noon, and the noon is silver, not a play.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Is Thursday the gown I have, sir, or will someone lengthen it again before then?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thursday is the gown thou hast. I will not promise a new hem on a Monday, and I will not have thee hoping for one.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Then we stop. The line has been said twice. The second time is the one I will remember, and only because it finished.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Go and pay thy landlady, Will. A king who cannot chew may still count silver. God keep thee till tomorrow.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And thee. Leave the glass as he likes it. I have no business with it until the doors, and the doors are not today.
